verdict.rationale: CrewAI itself is distributed as an official, well-documented Python SDK/framework (pip/uv install, CLI, and rich concept docs for Agents, Tasks, Crews, Flows, Memory, Tools) that developers build directly against, and community projects confirm real-world usage of these APIs (e.g., knowledge_source, @after_kickoff decorators). Missing for 10: evidence of an official SDK in other languages (e.g., JS/TS) and a public API reference/OpenAPI spec (probe found no openapi.json), which would round out 'SDK' completeness for a purely programmatic integration story.
